tools.name: lsp_prepare_workspace_root
tools.description: Briefly explain in the language of the user's latest message that Semantic JS MCP limits which directories it can analyze to protect their files from malicious repository instructions; the model cannot widen that boundary, and authorization applies only to Semantic JS MCP for this session. Then ask whether to use the current Codex project or another directory. Canonicalizes the selection without granting access; require confirmation of canonicalRoot before lsp_authorize_workspace_root.

root.description: Absolute directory selected by the human; use the current Codex project unless they choose another

tools.name: lsp_authorize_workspace_root
tools.description: Before calling, ask in the language of the user's latest message whether to authorize the exact prepared canonical root for Semantic JS MCP during this session. Adds that root to this MCP process only. This security-sensitive tool requires a human Codex approval; never call it from model inference alone. Continue with lsp_document_symbols.

tools.name: lsp_document_symbols
tools.description: Returns declarations and nested members for one file. Use lsp_definition or lsp_audit_symbol with an exact position for semantic identity.

file.description: Absolute path to a TypeScript, JavaScript, TSX, JSX, or Vue file

root.description: Optional absolute workspace or repository root

maxResults.description: Optional number of symbols to return; omit to return all collected symbols

tools.name: lsp_workspace_symbols
tools.description: Returns declaration-shaped symbols whose names contain a query. Use lsp_count_named_symbol or lsp_audit_named_symbol with an exact name.

maxResults.description: Optional number of symbols to return; omit to return all collected symbols

maxCandidates.description: Optional number of text matches to inspect; omit to inspect all matches

tools.name: lsp_definition
tools.description: Resolves definitions for one source position. Use lsp_hover for type information or lsp_count_references for impact scope.

file.description: Absolute path to a TypeScript, JavaScript, TSX, JSX, or Vue file

root.description: Optional absolute workspace or repository root

maxResults.description: Optional number of definitions to return; omit to return all resolved definitions

tools.name: lsp_hover
tools.description: Returns inferred type information and documentation for one source position. Use lsp_definition for declaration identity.

file.description: Absolute path to a TypeScript, JavaScript, TSX, JSX, or Vue file

root.description: Optional absolute workspace or repository root

tools.name: lsp_diagnostics
tools.description: Returns diagnostics for one file, separates unconfirmed context, and states whether the result is usable as current-document diagnostic evidence.

file.description: Absolute path to a TypeScript, JavaScript, TSX, JSX, or Vue file

root.description: Optional absolute workspace or repository root

maxResults.description: Optional number of diagnostics to return; omit to return all reported diagnostics

tools.name: lsp_call_hierarchy
tools.description: Collects a bounded static incoming, outgoing, or bidirectional call graph from one source position. Reports provider gaps and cycles explicitly; use lsp_call_hierarchy_page for later edges. This does not establish runtime reachability.

file.description: Absolute path to a TypeScript, JavaScript, TSX, JSX, or Vue file

root.description: Optional absolute workspace or repository root

maxDepth.description: Maximum static traversal depth; at most 6

pageSize.description: Number of edges to return; default 100

tools.name: lsp_call_hierarchy_page
tools.description: Returns a page from a freshness-checked static call-hierarchy set.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous call-hierarchy page

pageSize.description: Number of edges to return; default 100

tools.name: lsp_count_text_matches
tools.description: Counts exact identifier text matches without semantic verification. Use lsp_count_named_symbol or lsp_audit_named_symbol to verify identity.

symbol.description: Exact JavaScript or TypeScript identifier text to count

tools.name: lsp_count_named_symbol
tools.description: Returns exact-definition and verified-reference counts plus explicit semantic follow-up status for a symbol name. Use lsp_audit_named_symbol for identity, signature, or file-hint binding verification and lsp_reference_page with a returned referenceSetId for locations.

fileHint.description: Optional path fragment used to select exact homonymous definitions

maxDefinitions.description: Optional number of exact homonymous definitions to analyze; omit to analyze all

maxCandidates.description: Optional number of text matches to verify; omit to verify all

tools.name: lsp_count_references
tools.description: Returns verified-reference counts for the symbol at one source position. Use lsp_audit_symbol for identity and signature or lsp_reference_page with the returned referenceSetId for locations.

file.description: Absolute path to a TypeScript, JavaScript, TSX, JSX, or Vue file

root.description: Optional absolute workspace or repository root

crossWorkspace.description: Include text matches from other workspaces after definition verification

maxCandidates.description: Optional number of text matches to verify; omit to verify all

tools.name: lsp_audit_named_symbol
tools.description: Returns a compact exact-name audit with explicit semantic follow-up status and verifies source bindings to fileHint when no declaration is selected. Use lsp_reference_page with a returned referenceSetId for locations.

fileHint.description: Optional path fragment used to select exact homonymous definitions

maxDefinitions.description: Optional number of exact homonymous definitions to analyze; omit to analyze all

maxCandidates.description: Optional number of text matches to verify; omit to verify all

tools.name: lsp_audit_symbol
tools.description: Returns a compact definition, signature, coverage, and freshness summary for one source position. Use lsp_reference_page with the returned referenceSetId for locations.

file.description: Absolute path to a TypeScript, JavaScript, TSX, JSX, or Vue file

root.description: Optional absolute workspace or repository root

crossWorkspace.description: Include text matches from other workspaces after definition verification

maxCandidates.description: Optional number of text matches to verify; omit to verify all

tools.name: lsp_references
tools.description: Returns the first page of verified source locations and detailed collection evidence. Use lsp_reference_page for later pages.

file.description: Absolute path to a TypeScript, JavaScript, TSX, JSX, or Vue file

root.description: Optional absolute workspace or repository root

crossWorkspace.description: Include text matches from other workspaces after definition verification

maxCandidates.description: Optional number of text matches to verify; omit to verify all

pageSize.description: Number of reference locations to return in this page; default 100

tools.name: lsp_reference_page
tools.description: Returns a page from a freshness-checked reference set created by a count, audit, or lsp_references call.

referenceSetId.description: Reference-set identifier returned by lsp_references, lsp_count_references, or an audit tool

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous reference page

pageSize.description: Number of reference locations to return; default 100

tools.name: lsp_unresolved_reference_page
tools.description: Returns freshness-checked text-match candidates whose definitions could not be resolved, including literal failure reasons.

referenceSetId.description: Reference-set identifier returned by a count, audit, or reference tool

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous unresolved-reference page

pageSize.description: Number of unresolved candidates to return; default 100
